emptyState.title: No mailboxes
emptyState.subtitle: Add a connection to load folders

disclosure.en: Read/unread, star/unstar and archive are local prototype updates; external mailbox effects are not enforced here.

automation_requirements.acceptance: When Automation runs, toggling read/star and archiving must update the remote mailbox via the required capability.
automation_requirements.statement: Support only read/unread, star/unstar, and archive, each from an explicit user gesture

disclosure.en: This app requires capability mail.messages.manage ^1.0.0 to list, inspect and archive messages. No provider is named.

automation_requirements.acceptance: Capability is declared and bound by Automation without naming a specific provider.
automation_requirements.statement: The semantic Application must require the existing portable capability mail.messages.manage ^1
